model.name: Scenario Skybox Flux.1
model.shortDescription: Generate seamless 360 equirectangular panoramas from a text prompt, powered by FLUX.1. Choose from 22 styles with automatic seam and pole correction.

inputs.description: Describe the scene you want to see all around you — a sunset beach, a futuristic city, a forest at dawn. The model automatically formats your prompt to produce a seamless 360° panorama.
inputs.label: Prompt
inputs.name: prompt

inputs.description: The artistic look of your panorama. Choose from cinematic, fantasy, cyberpunk, oil painting, and more. Each style shapes the color palette, lighting, and overall mood. Use Standard for a neutral, unstyled result.
inputs.label: Style
inputs.name: style

inputs.description: Describe what you don't want in the image — e.g. 'blurry, people, text'. Has no effect unless Negative Prompt Strength is above 0. Try generating without one first to see if it's needed.
inputs.label: Negative Prompt
inputs.name: negativePrompt

inputs.description: How strongly the model avoids what you described in the Negative Prompt. Leave at 0 to disable it entirely. Increase gradually — values between 1–4 are usually enough.
inputs.label: Negative Prompt Strength
inputs.name: negativePromptStrength

inputs.description: Upload an existing image to use as a starting point. The model will generate a new panorama inspired by it, with the amount of change controlled by the Strength slider below.
inputs.label: Reference Image
inputs.name: image

inputs.description: How much the model transforms your reference image. Low values stay close to the original; high values produce a more creative, reimagined result.
inputs.label: Strength
inputs.name: strength

inputs.description: How many panoramas to generate at once. Useful for exploring variations before committing to one.
inputs.label: Skybox Count
inputs.name: numOutputs

inputs.description: Number of refinement passes the model takes. More steps generally produce sharper, more detailed results but take longer. 30 is a good default.
inputs.label: Sampling Steps
inputs.name: numInferenceSteps

inputs.description: Fine-tunes how strongly the model enforces correct 360° geometry. Leave at 0 to use the recommended level for your chosen style. Increase only if the panorama seam or poles look distorted.
inputs.label: 360 Scale Level
inputs.name: geometryEnforcement

inputs.description: A number that locks in the randomness of the generation. Copy the seed from a result you liked to reproduce it exactly, or leave blank for a new result each time.
inputs.label: Seed
inputs.name: seed
